search_strategy:

  objective:
    - identify high-probability opportunities
    - prioritize Germany-focused autonomous mobility deployment and execution leadership
    - use ADAS and vehicle software delivery as the secondary lane
    - selectively consider AI-enabled transformation leadership
    - identify roles where transferable program leadership matters
    - identify companies worth networking with even when no suitable vacancy exists
    - avoid low-probability applications caused by hidden technical or commercial requirements

  preferred_actions:
    - APPLY_NOW
    - NETWORK_FIRST
    - EXPLORE
    - WATCH
    - SKIP

  principles:
    - Do not rely only on job-title similarity.
    - Evaluate actual task content and required experience.
    - Treat transferable experience separately from direct experience.
    - Do not invent or assume missing candidate experience.
    - Strong automotive experience should be treated as an asset, not as a boundary.
    - Germany-China experience should increase relevance when international or cross-border context matters.
    - Roles requiring deep hands-on engineering should not receive high scores solely because the domain matches.
    - Roles requiring quota-carrying sales should be treated cautiously.
    - Networking potential is part of opportunity quality.
    - Companies can be strategically relevant even when there is no current suitable vacancy.

strategy_policy:
  positioning: "Germany-focused autonomous mobility deployment, technical program delivery, launch readiness, operations and ecosystem integration; Berlin preferred."
  # Allocations guide search effort; they are not capability-score multipliers.
  autonomy_terms: [autonomous, robotics, robot, AMR, warehouse automation, logistics automation, fleet orchestration, simulation, mapping, sensor, intelligent transportation]
  domain_advantage_terms: [automotive, mobility, vehicle, ADAS, industrial, manufacturing]
  secondary_relevance_terms: [ADAS, automated driving, vehicle software, software, infotainment, mobility, data, autonomy]
  ai_data_terms: [AI, A.I., analytics, reporting, data, machine learning]
  delivery_terms: [launch readiness, partner integration, ecosystem integration, program, deployment, integration, delivery, product owner, product operations, fleet operations, fleet readiness, customer deployment, partnership manager, solution lead, solutions lead, reporting specialist, adoption, process transformation]
  executive_terms: [chief of staff, founder’s associate, "founder's associate", executive assistant]
  engineering_title_terms: [AI engineer, software engineer, software developer, perception engineer, planning engineer, controls engineer, control engineer, mechatronics, robotics architect, robotics engineer, robotics software engineer, robotics hardware engineer, robotics software developer, robot software engineer, machine learning engineer, ML engineer, AI architect, data engineer, research scientist, AI researcher]
  unsupported_leadership_terms: [head of enterprise AI, head of AI transformation, production AI transformations]
  bridge_support_terms: [adoption, process transformation, stakeholder leadership, program delivery, product delivery]
  candidate_apply_threshold: 65
  candidate_network_threshold: 60
  evidence_apply_threshold: 60
  evidence_network_threshold: 60
  cold_access_review_terms: [solution lead, professional services, technical solutions]
  evidence_anchors:
    direct: 85
    adjacent: 75
    unknown: 30
    adjacent_total_cap: 75
    high_anchor_transitions: [direct, adjacent]
    direct_role_capabilities: [technical_program_leadership, mobility_service_deployment, program_governance]
    direct_domain_capabilities: [adas_autonomous_driving, automotive_mobility]
  candidacy_weights:
    career_lane_fit: 0.20
    capability_fit: 0.30
    domain_fit: 0.20
    evidence_strength: 0.30
    location_fit: 0.0
    network_access: 0.0
  robotics_experience_patterns:
    - '(?:multiple|several|\d+\+?) years (?:of )?(?:direct |professional )?robotics(?:[- ]product)? experience'
  executive_requirement_terms:
    founder_execution: [founder-facing, founder-priority delivery]
    company_building: [company-building, build the company]
    finance: [financial modeling, financial modelling, financial planning, finance ownership]
    fundraising: [fundraising, investor relations, raise capital]
    commercial: [commercial ownership, revenue ownership]
    seniority: [junior, entry level, graduate, assistant]
  core_gap_strength_cap: 40
  decisive_mismatch_strength_cap: 25
  commissioning_review_title_terms: [AMR, robotics deployment, robot deployment, customer deployment]
  # Match explicit core requirements; optional technology exposure remains a review gap.
  core_requirement_terms:
    commercial: [commercial ownership, commercial heavy, commercially heavy, revenue ownership, sales quota]
    engineering: [hands-on robotics engineering, hands-on commissioning, Linux commissioning, robot configuration, field-engineering ownership, robot commissioning, commission robots, production ROS 2, perception algorithms, controls ownership, hardware ownership]
    technical: [DevOps depth required, data-platform depth required, deep cloud architecture required, production AI-platform ownership, production AI platform ownership]
  gap_rules:
    direct_professional_robotics_missing:
      terms: [robotics, robot, AMR]
      reason: Direct professional robotics experience is not evidenced; vehicle integration is transferable.
    production_ros2_missing:
      terms: [ROS 2, ROS2]
      reason: Production ROS 2 experience is missing; planned AMR work remains evidence in development.
    perception_planning_control_missing:
      terms: [perception, planning algorithms, controls, control algorithms]
      reason: Specialist perception/planning/control engineering is not evidenced.
    robot_hardware_missing:
      terms: [hardware, mechatronics, embedded systems]
      reason: Robot hardware or mechatronics engineering ownership is not evidenced.
    enterprise_ai_ownership_missing:
      terms: [enterprise AI, production AI transformations]
      reason: Commercial enterprise AI transformation ownership is not evidenced.
    production_ai_platform_missing:
      terms: [AI platform, data-platform, data platform]
      reason: Production AI/data-platform ownership is not evidenced.
    cloud_mlops_depth_missing:
      terms: [DevOps, MLOps, cloud architecture, data-platform]
      reason: Deep DevOps/MLOps/cloud architecture experience is not evidenced.
    commercial_ownership_needs_evidence:
      terms: [commercial, pre-sales, presales, business development, partnership manager]
      reason: Commercial/pre-sales ownership needs evidence; stakeholder coordination is not sales ownership.
    seniority_mismatch:
      terms: [junior, entry level, assistant, associate]
      reason: Role may undervalue 20+ years of seniority.

strength_scale:
  5:
    label: expert_core
    meaning: strong direct professional evidence

  4:
    label: strong
    meaning: substantial direct or highly transferable experience

  3:
    label: credible_adjacent
    meaning: relevant experience exists but may not be the primary career track

  2:
    label: limited
    meaning: some exposure or project evidence, but not sufficient for roles requiring deep experience

  1:
    label: gap
    meaning: no meaningful direct professional evidence

matching_rules:

  direct_experience:
    description: experience explicitly supported by documented professional history
    score_multiplier: 1.0

  transferable_experience:
    description: credible capability that can be applied in another industry or context
    score_multiplier: 0.8

  emerging_experience:
    description: recent learning or project-based evidence without extensive professional history
    score_multiplier: 0.6

  adjacent_experience:
    description: partial overlap but not a primary professional track
    score_multiplier: 0.4

  gap:
    description: insufficient documented evidence
    score_multiplier: 0.1

assessment_principles:

  - Never infer a capability that is not supported by evidence.
  - Distinguish direct professional experience from transferable experience.
  - Distinguish professional experience from coursework and portfolio projects.
  - Do not treat domain familiarity as proof of role-specific capability.
  - Do not treat stakeholder management as sales experience.
  - Do not treat program leadership as formal people management.
  - Do not treat AI upskilling as senior AI engineering experience.
  - Do not treat software projects as equivalent to a senior software-engineering career.
  - Strong ADAS and automotive experience should increase fit for autonomy and robotics roles when the underlying capabilities transfer.
  - Germany-China experience should increase fit when the role includes international, cross-border or APAC responsibilities.
  - High domain fit must not override a major capability gap.
  - Roles with high-risk gaps should be flagged even if overall semantic similarity is high.

candidate_strength_model:
  automotive_adas_vehicle_delivery: very_strong
  autonomous_mobility_deployment: strong
  autonomous_systems_programs: credible_adjacency
  robotics_product_programs: developing_adjacency
  automotive_ai_transformation: selective_bridge
  enterprise_ai_transformation: weak_to_moderate
  ai_engineering_architecture: weak
  robotics_engineering: weak
project_evidence:
  ai_data_prototypes:
    status: prototype
    scope: Technical literacy, learning velocity and prototype execution only.
  ros2_amr:
    status: in_development
    professional_experience: false
    evidence: []
config_files.config/constraints.yaml:
constraints:

  location:

    relocation_required:
      severity: high
      default_action: SKIP
      reason: Candidate does not currently want to relocate.

    china_based_role:
      severity: high
      default_action: SKIP
      reason: China-based relocation is currently not preferred.

    munich_only:
      severity: high
      default_action: SKIP
      reason: Berlin is the preferred base and Munich relocation is not desired.

    berlin_or_remote_germany:
      severity: positive
      default_action: BOOST
      reason: Strong location fit.

    germany_hybrid_with_limited_travel:
      severity: positive
      default_action: BOOST
      reason: Acceptable working model if travel remains reasonable.

    frequent_travel_required:
      severity: high
      default_action: SKIP
      reason: Explicit frequent travel conflicts with occasional domestic travel only.


  seniority:

    junior_role:
      severity: high
      default_action: SKIP
      reason: Role is likely below the candidate's experience level.

    clearly_mid_level_execution_only:
      severity: medium
      default_action: REVIEW
      reason: May underuse senior program and stakeholder-management experience.

    senior_program_or_operations_role:
      severity: positive
      default_action: BOOST
      reason: Strong alignment with experience level.

    principal_engineering_role:
      severity: high
      default_action: REVIEW
      reason: Principal-level engineering roles may require deeper hands-on technical depth than documented.


  engineering_depth:

    deep_cloud_architecture:
      severity: high
      default_action: HIGH_RISK
      reason: No strong evidence of deep hands-on AWS, Azure or GCP architecture experience.

    senior_software_engineering:
      severity: high
      default_action: HIGH_RISK
      reason: Candidate is not positioned as a senior software engineer.

    production_ml_engineering:
      severity: high
      default_action: HIGH_RISK
      reason: AI and ML experience is credible but not equivalent to several years of production ML engineering.

    deep_data_engineering:
      severity: high
      default_action: HIGH_RISK
      reason: Limited evidence of large-scale production data-platform ownership.

    spark_kafka_platform_engineering:
      severity: high
      default_action: HIGH_RISK
      reason: Roles centered on large-scale data infrastructure are not a core match.

    coding_heavy_role:
      severity: high
      default_action: REVIEW
      reason: Coding-heavy delivery should not be inferred from technical program experience.

    architecture_plus_program_role:
      severity: medium
      default_action: REVIEW
      reason: Can be relevant if architecture responsibility is coordination-oriented rather than hands-on ownership.


  product:

    several_years_formal_product_owner_required:
      severity: high
      default_action: HIGH_RISK
      reason: Candidate has product-adjacent experience but not a long formal PO track record.

    product_operations:
      severity: positive
      default_action: BOOST
      reason: Stronger match than pure Product Owner roles.

    technical_product_program:
      severity: positive
      default_action: BOOST
      reason: Strong alignment with program leadership and technical-business translation.


  commercial:

    quota_carrying_sales:
      severity: high
      default_action: SKIP
      reason: No evidence of quota-carrying sales ownership.

    enterprise_sales:
      severity: high
      default_action: HIGH_RISK
      reason: Stakeholder management should not be confused with enterprise sales.

    revenue_target_ownership:
      severity: high
      default_action: HIGH_RISK
      reason: Direct commercial ownership is not a core capability.

    partnerships_without_sales_quota:
      severity: medium
      default_action: REVIEW
      reason: Partnership roles can fit when focused on ecosystem coordination rather than pure sales.

    strategic_partnerships:
      severity: positive
      default_action: BOOST
      reason: Can leverage cross-company stakeholder and international experience.
      
    commercial_business_development:
      severity: high
      default_action: REVIEW
      reason: Role may be substantially more commercially oriented than the candidate's core program and operations background.


  people_management:

    large_direct_report_organization:
      severity: high
      default_action: REVIEW
      reason: Program leadership should not automatically be treated as large-scale disciplinary people management.

    team_lead_without_large_org_requirement:
      severity: medium
      default_action: REVIEW
      reason: May fit depending on whether leadership is functional, program-based or disciplinary.

decision_rules:

  hard_skip:
    conditions:
      - relocation_required
      - china_based_role
      - munich_only
      - quota_carrying_sales

  high_risk:

  positive_boosters:

      - chinese_language_required
      - international_program
      - mobility
      - robotics
      - enterprise_technology
      - logistics_technology
      - industrial_automation


constraint_principles:

  - Hard constraints are evaluated before opportunity scoring.
  - A high semantic or domain match must not override a hard skip.
  - High-risk flags do not always mean automatic rejection.
  - REVIEW means the job description requires human inspection before a decision.
  - BOOST means the factor can improve opportunity quality but should not guarantee a high score.
  - Automotive familiarity should be treated as an advantage, not as a requirement.
  - Broader technology roles are valid when transferable capabilities match strongly.
  - Robotics roles should be differentiated between program/deployment roles and deep engineering/research roles.
  - AI roles should be differentiated between transformation/program roles and production engineering/research roles.
  - Germany-China experience should be treated as a strategic differentiator when relevant, not as a universal requirement.
  - Location preference should be enforced independently from role attractiveness.
location_enforcement:
  outside_region_daily_terms: [daily presence, daily on-site, daily onsite, five days on-site, 5 days onsite]
  outside_region_cities: [Munich, München, Hamburg, Wolfsburg, Stuttgart, Frankfurt, Hannover, Cologne, Düsseldorf]
  remote_terms: [remote Germany, remote in Germany, Germany remote]
config_files.config/network_profile.yaml:
candidate:
  profile_name: lingjia_gardner

network_model:

  relationship_levels:

    none:
      score: 0
      description: No known contact or relationship.

    observed:
      score: 15
      description: Person or company is known, but there has been no direct interaction.

    cold_connection:
      score: 30
      description: LinkedIn connection or weak contact without meaningful conversation.

    warm_contact:
      score: 50
      description: Some direct interaction, exchange or prior conversation exists.

    active_conversation:
      score: 70
      description: Ongoing direct conversation about company, role, technology or collaboration.

    inbound_contact:
      score: 85
      description: The company or relevant person proactively approached the candidate.

    internal_team_access:
      score: 80
      description: Documented direct access to the internal team.
    employee_referral:
      score: 90
      description: Documented employee referral.
    hiring_manager_access:
      score: 90
      description: Documented direct hiring-manager access.
    internal_sponsor:
      score: 95
      description: Documented internal sponsor.
    warm_introduction:
      score: 70
      description: Credible warm introduction.
    prior_working_relationship:
      score: 75
      description: Documented prior working relationship.

    internal_advocate:
      score: 95
      description: A trusted person inside the company is actively supporting or referring the candidate.


  contact_relevance:

    recruiter:
      weight: 0.7

    hiring_manager:
      weight: 1.0

    team_member:
      weight: 0.8

    senior_leader:
      weight: 0.9

    technical_lead:
      weight: 0.9

    former_colleague:
      weight: 0.8

    mutual_connection:
      weight: 0.6

    unknown:
      weight: 0.5


  interaction_recency:

    within_7_days:
      multiplier: 1.0

    within_30_days:
      multiplier: 0.9

    within_90_days:
      multiplier: 0.75

    older_than_90_days:
      multiplier: 0.5

    unknown:
      multiplier: 0.6


  strategic_company_relevance:

    high:
      bonus: 15

    medium:
      bonus: 8

    low:
      bonus: 0


companies:

  moia:
    company_name: MOIA
    strategic_relevance: high
    relationship_level: inbound_contact

    contacts:
      - name: null
        role_type: technical_lead
        relationship_level: inbound_contact
        last_interaction: recent
        notes:
          - Proactive outreach after MIA registration.
          - Relevant to autonomous mobility, simulation and deployment.

  motor_ai:
    company_name: MOTOR Ai
    strategic_relevance: high
    relationship_level: observed

    contacts: []

  waymo:
    company_name: Waymo
    strategic_relevance: high
    relationship_level: observed

    contacts: []

  freenow:
    company_name: FREENOW
    strategic_relevance: medium
    relationship_level: warm_contact

    contacts:
      - name: null
        role_type: recruiter
        relationship_level: warm_contact
        last_interaction: recent
        notes:
          - Previous recruiting process and follow-up exchange.

  uber:
    company_name: Uber
    strategic_relevance: medium
    relationship_level: warm_contact

    contacts:
      - name: null
        role_type: recruiter
        relationship_level: warm_contact
        last_interaction: recent
        notes:
          - Previous recruiting interaction and follow-up.

network_scoring_rules:

  unknown_company_default:
    relationship_level: none
    base_score: 0

  maximum_score: 100

  principles:
    - Network access must be based on documented interaction, not assumed familiarity.
    - A LinkedIn connection alone is weaker than an active conversation.
    - Inbound outreach is a strong positive signal.
    - Hiring-manager or technical-lead access is more valuable than generic recruiter access.
    - Recent interaction is more valuable than an old dormant contact.
    - Strategic company relevance can modestly increase network opportunity quality.
    - Network strength should influence recommended action but must not override hard capability or location constraints.
    - NETWORK_FIRST requires sufficient strategic/capability fit and cold access; documented referrals or hiring-manager relationships prevent it.
    - Core capability gaps require WATCH or SKIP; network access never compensates for them.
